question: Do the Greyscale Design 'Simons Addition' drawings apply to this 308 Evergreen Street job?
why_it_matters: Every physical layout, structural, and material fact used for planning comes from these drawings, but the project name doesn't match the scope document.
unblocks: Whether to use the drawing set's room layout, dimensions, and materials as the design basis for the plan.

choices: Yes, same job — use drawings as design basis
Unconfirmed — verify with designer/customer before use

question: Which addition footprint should drive quantity takeoffs: ~590 sf (drawings), ~300 sf (scope), or 789 sf (breakdown)?
why_it_matters: Framing, roofing, siding, drywall, and paint quantities and durations scale directly with footprint, and the three documents disagree by up to 2.6x.
unblocks: Sizing of foundation, framing, roofing, and interior-finish task durations and material quantities.

question: Should the roof framing use trusses or site-built rafters?
why_it_matters: Trusses carry a long procurement lead time that must be scheduled early; rafters don't, and the addition's ~29'-5" span exceeds the company default's truss-consideration threshold.
unblocks: Whether an early long-lead truss procurement task is inserted before framing.

choices: Still undetermined — confirm with PM/design phase

question: Does the LVL beam opening the existing load-bearing wall need sealed structural engineering before permit submittal?
why_it_matters: No structural or engineering drawings support this beam anywhere in the file, and the only drawing set on hand is issued by a non-licensed designer.
unblocks: Whether an engineering-review task is added before the building permit application.

choices: Yes — obtain sealed engineering/PE review before permit
No — local AHJ accepts unsealed prescriptive sizing

question: Will this job modify or relocate the septic system, or keep the existing system as-is?
why_it_matters: TDEC septic permitting requires a 6-week lead time and the job must never break ground while it's pending, but the scope leaves this undecided.
unblocks: Whether a TDEC septic permit task is added to the plan and when it must start relative to the scheduled start date.

choices: Keep existing septic — no TDEC permit triggered
Relocate or install new septic tank/leach field — TDEC required
Install grinder pump system — TDEC required

question: Are the covered deck, exterior stairs, and interior stairs shown in drawings part of contracted scope?
why_it_matters: Neither the scope narrative nor the cost breakdown has any deck or stair line item, yet drawings show a full deck/stair assembly and interior stairs.
unblocks: Whether deck_build and stair_build tasks are added to the plan at all.

choices: No — excluded, treat as change-order opportunity

question: Should the below-grade waterproofing/drainage package be included given the sloped-lot condition shown in drawings?
why_it_matters: The job-type default calls for a below-grade package on sloped/walkout additions, but the scope explicitly excludes foundation waterproofing/drains 'unless specified.'
unblocks: Whether a below-grade waterproofing/drainage phase is added between foundation and framing.

choices: Yes — include per default for sloped-lot additions

question: Is the optional closet/cabinet organization system accepted as part of this job's scope?
why_it_matters: It's priced as a separate option in the scope but has no corresponding line item anywhere in the cost breakdown.
unblocks: Whether a cabinets/closet-organization install task is added to the plan.

question: Are the Garage and Lounge rooms on the basement plan new contracted work or existing space shown for reference?
why_it_matters: The scope only describes 'basement storage,' but the drawings' basement plan also shows a Garage and a Lounge with no corresponding scope or cost line items.
unblocks: Whether basement framing/finish tasks need to cover these rooms beyond storage.

choices: Existing space, shown for reference only — not contracted work
New construction — part of contracted addition scope

choices: Brick veneer at base + vinyl above, per drawings

unblocks: Correct placement of the foundation and framing phases on the timeline.

choices: Yes — delay foundation/framing until after mid-Feb 2027
No — exception granted for this job/site conditions
Scheduled start date itself needs to move
